source_resolution.argument: At a sphere point the SO(2) isotropy kills mixed one-form components; transitivity makes the remaining coefficients functions on U. The two source-free Maxwell equations make r squared times the electric coefficient and the magnetic coefficient constant. Surface restrictions give the stated fluxes.

source_resolution.argument: Extends the two-dimensional metric to a four-dimensional product with two flat factors; the exact four-dimensional Levi-Civita and curvature interfaces yield the base curvature components. Pair symmetries reduce the base Ricci tensor to its single independent component, and a direct determinant calculation proves the base volume form is parallel.
